channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Paras endure Belize jungle for tough training
item.description: Paratroopers from 3rd Battalion The Parachute Regiment have completed a month of intensive training in the jungles of Belize, an environment the Army describes as one of the most demanding it routinely uses. The post Paras endure Belize jungle for tough training first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Babcock offer drone warships with Type 31 command ships
item.description: Babcock has set out a plan to turn the Royal Navy’s Type 31 frigates into command vessels for a fleet of large HII-built autonomous warships. The post Babcock offer drone warships with Type 31 command ships first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British maritime patrol aircraft surge to Iceland
item.description: The RAF has carried out its largest ever deployment of P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft, sending three jets from 120 Squadron to Keflavik Air Base in Iceland as part of NATO vigilance activity. The post British maritime patrol aircraft surge to Iceland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK to scale back military training exercises outside Europe
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that the Armed Forces will begin reducing the number of overseas training exercises from next year. The post UK to scale back military training exercises outside Europe first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Keel laid in Rosyth for new British warship
item.description: Babcock has laid the keel for HMS Formidable at Rosyth, marking the next scheduled milestone in the Type 31 frigate programme, which will deliver five ships to the Royal Navy within 10 years of contract signing. The post Keel laid in Rosyth for new British warship first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Anduril and GKN join forces for British Army combat drone
item.description: Anduril UK and GKN Aerospace have signed an exclusive teaming agreement to deliver the airframe for the British Army’s Project NYX. The post Anduril and GKN join forces for British Army combat drone first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British armed forces member dies in Ukraine
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has announced that a member of the UK Armed Forces died in Ukraine on Tuesday, 9 December, following what officials described as a “tragic accident” during a weapons trial conducted by Ukrainian forces. The post British armed forces member dies in Ukraine first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US taps Babcock to build parts for Virginia subs in Scotland
item.description: HII and Babcock have signed a new contract that will see major sections of US Virginia-class submarines built in Scotland, deepening industrial links between the two countries and broadening the AUKUS supply base. The post US taps Babcock to build parts for Virginia subs in Scotland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Babcock offers drone warships with British frigates in 2027
item.description: Speaking under the hulls of Type 31 Frigates at Rosyth, Babcock’s senior leadership told the UK Defence Journal how they intend to meet the First Sea Lord’s call for rapid expansion of autonomous mass at sea, with a drone ship alongside HMS Venturer in 2027. The post Babcock offers drone warships with British frigates in 2027 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: The First Sea Lord wants a Navy built for risk, nothing less
item.description: Britain’s grip on the Atlantic is slipping, the First Sea Lord told the Council of Geostrategy’s Sea Power Conference, urging a fleet rebuilt for speed, autonomy and adaptation so the Royal Navy can hold the line in a world tilting toward danger. The post The First Sea Lord wants a Navy built for risk, nothing less first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
